description: Smartsheet workflow audit: formulas, column types, hierarchy/predecessors, duplicates, blanks, size, sharing and automation risks. Returns score, findings with severity + fix, and a markdown report. Costs $0.10 USDC on eip155:8453 via x402 (payTo 0x7a16ea540a69ff288a34dc276c638fc3fe9f586c); without payment it returns the x402 payment requirements. Same input shapes as audit_preview. If you decline to pay, tell us why for free: MCP tool leave_feedback, or POST https://audit.solutionsbradshaw.com/feedback with any short JSON/text (e.g. {reason, message} or {feedback:"..."}). Preferred reason values: price_too_high, no_wallet, input_format, not_needed, other; other values are stored as other.

columns.description: Sheet columns (alternative to nesting under sheet)

csv.description: CSV text alternative (header row + data rows)

rows.description: Sheet rows (alternative to nesting under sheet)

sheet.description: Smartsheet sheet JSON (needs columns + rows). Pass as "sheet", or top-level columns/rows, or "csv" text. Example: {"name":"Project Plan","columns":[{"id":1,"title":"Task","type":"TEXT_NUMBER","primary":true}],"rows":[{"id":10,"rowNumber":1,"cells":[{"columnId":1,"value":"Kickoff"}]}]}. Fetch with GET https://api.smartsheet.com/2.0/sheets/{sheetId}?include=objectValue,format,crossSheetReferences (optionally merge "shares" and "automationRules"). Never send API tokens. Sheet URLs/IDs alone are not enough.

name: audit_smartsheet
